comments.text: What makes Eritrea especially fascinating is how family traditions can shape an entire life cycle, from birth and marriage to mourning and remembrance. 🇪🇷 The role of elders, ancestry and community seems far stronger than in many modern societies where major life decisions are increasingly individual. Seeing the same cultural symbols reappear across generations makes these traditions feel less like isolated rituals and more like a system holding families together.
